areas.name: Sustainable cities
areas.reason: Mobility objective directly tied to sustainable mobility; two components with viable indicators and targets (travel time, crowding, accessible sidewalks); resource share above 90%; high impact.

areas.name: Environment
areas.reason: Relevant through emissions reduction, fleet electrification, active mobility and nature-based solutions (about a third of resources); indicators not fully SMART; limited reach gives low impact.

areas.name: Trade
areas.reason: Only partly pertinent; indicators measure cross-border freight only, not export expansion or diversification; no resource allocation evidenced, so impact could not be assessed.

areas.name: International cooperation and regional development
areas.reason: Logistics-integration component is aligned, but indicators measure freight only and targets were judged unviable; bridge and access works contribute only partially, so low impact.
